value.rationale: The motivating 2026 work explicitly requests higher-dimensional extensions and regularization of singular reset-site information. The sharp geometric threshold alpha=d-2 classifies center-versus-shell concentration for a natural continuous family of singular diffusivities, and the reset-information divergence changes sign at the same threshold with an exceptional 2D logarithmic endpoint. This complete structural phase classification has independent mathematical motivation, rather than an arbitrary slice or numerical computation.
